learning_outcomes.text: Possess in-depth knowledge of essential digital components and their structure, as well as digital circuit technology.
Are familiar with electronic circuits and the interconnection of digital components into complex functional units.
Possess the competence for independent digital circuit design.
Are familiar with the essential principles of object-oriented programming.
Possess the competence to apply problem-oriented design, selection, and analysis methods for algorithms and data structures.
Can use fundamental algorithms and data structures in programming.

syllabus_topics: Digital basic circuits: synchronous and asynchronous counters
Structure and functioning of programmable digital circuits (FPGA, CPLD)
In-depth concepts of object-oriented programming using a relevant programming language
Fundamental data structures for sequences, sets, trees
Fundamentals of analysis and complexity quantification of algorithms
